description: Queue fresh research for the exact pending-plan preview, up to 100 tickets. By default persists a research-only hold on the returned requests, including reused work. With auto_run:true (matching the preview) it sets no hold, so each fresh plan follows the ordinary auto-run eligibility rule. Never replays old effects. Requires a new preview if work changed; successful repeats return the original receipt.
